shots.text: Frostmere was a frozen sea, and the Tidefolk kept every memory of the world in its ice.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A vast frozen lake, stilt towns, pearl-white harbours, aurora overhead.

shots.text: Then the Flame came running across it, and the memories began to melt.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Burning runners skating across the ice, leaving black water behind them. At their head a boy made of white embers with a messenger's satchel: Ashwick.
